description_for_human: Sub-millisecond trajectory observability and deterministic execution firewalls for autonomous AI agents.
description_for_model: Bartholomew Trust Protocol (BTP v5.4) provides sub-35us in-process AST invariant gating, real-time OWASP kill-switches, secret credential scrubbing, and Ed25519 cryptographic receipts for autonomous AI agents. Use this service to audit trajectories, verify tool calls before execution, sanitize credentials, and generate non-human identity (NHI) passports.
